title: precheck warns when researched would read a research goal's lead-in together with its first question
goal: backlog.py precheck prints a warning for a research item whose goal_questions output joins a lead-in sentence of more than QUESTION_LEAD_WORDS words to its first question, naming the item, so a planner moves the lead-in to notes before the start gate; in SP-5dffnlxn the first worker found it after its claim and ten goals were re-planned mid-sprint.
